name: spotpuls
title: Spotpuls — European Electricity Spot Prices, 7-Day Forecast & Grid Tariff API
description: Free, zero-auth REST API and knowledge base for hourly European day-ahead electricity spot prices (40 bidding zones), self-learning 7-day Log-Merit + Hist-GBDT regional forecasts, smart-home load shifting (Home Assistant, Shelly, EVCC, Victron), and Finnish postal grid tariffs (33 DSOs).
